title: API: The Golden Year
summary:
API: The Golden Year
Since 1956, industry experts have been gathering biennially for the API Tanker Conference. This year's conference entitled, "Natural Disaster Response and Recovery" featured several well-appointed panels. This topic is especially fitting as many shipping, refining and oil companies were devastated in last year's hurricane season and the 2006 hurricane season has just begun.
